title: Checking Into a Hotel
summaryZh: 旅客到飯店辦理入住，確認房間位置、早餐時間和無線網路密碼。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Hi, I have a room here for two nights.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我在這裡訂了兩晚的房間。
sentences.note: for two 的 for 弱讀成 /fɚ/，不要唸成重音。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Welcome to our hotel! Can I have your name?
sentences.zh: 歡迎光臨本飯店！可以給我您的名字嗎？
sentences.note: Can I → /kənaɪ/，兩字連讀成一組音節。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Sure, my name is Anna Lin, from Taipei.
sentences.zh: 好的，我叫 Anna Lin，從台北來的。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Thank you. I see your room here, Miss Lin.
sentences.zh: 謝謝您。林小姐，我看到您的房間了。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: You have room four ten on the fourth floor.
sentences.zh: 您的房間是四樓的四一零號房。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Great, thanks. Is my room quiet at night?
sentences.zh: 太好了，謝謝。我的房間晚上安靜嗎？

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Yes, it faces the garden, so it's very quiet.
sentences.zh: 很安靜，房間面向花園，所以非常安靜。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: That sounds perfect. What time do you serve breakfast?
sentences.zh: 聽起來太棒了。你們早餐幾點供應？
sentences.note: What time do you → /wʌtaɪm dʒə/，do you 縮成 /dʒə/。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Breakfast is from seven to ten every morning.
sentences.zh: 早餐每天早上七點到十點供應。
sentences.note: from seven to ten 的 to 弱讀成 /tə/，不要唸成 /tuː/。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Good to know. Is there wifi in the room?
sentences.zh: 知道了。房間裡有無線網路嗎？

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Of course. The password is on your room key.
sentences.zh: 當然有。密碼就印在您的房卡上。
sentences.note: Of course → /əvˈkɔɹs/，of 弱讀，聽起來像 'v course。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Perfect. Can I leave my bags here for now?
sentences.zh: 太好了。我可以先把行李放在這裡嗎？

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Sure, we keep them behind the desk for you.
sentences.zh: 當然，我們會幫您放在櫃台後面。
sentences.note: keep them 的 them 弱讀成 /ðəm/ 甚至 /əm/，聽起來像 keep'em。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Thank you so much. Have a nice day!
sentences.zh: 非常謝謝你。祝你有美好的一天！

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: You too. Enjoy your stay here with us, Miss Lin!
sentences.zh: 您也是。林小姐，祝您住得愉快！
